scope: Fixed preregistered benchmark sessions and cases; engineering decision scores, no calibrated cross-VM95coverage or universal-host claim
semantic_arms: base always baselineversion, head always candidateversion; baseline_source/candidate_source map to physical directories

metrics: logical typedRPC and actual IPC attempt spans
context transaction span from first plan/contextRPC to last delivery RPC
daemon RSS after warmup, bounded16CLI burst and5second idle
auxiliary_probes.qualification_latency_source: Main uninstrumented CLI rows only; auxiliary CLI wall times never substitute

budget.total_domain_cli_scope: Measurement32sessions only; quality/preflight and analysis are separately bounded phases

decision_scores.interpretation: Resample matched call pairs within each fixed declared session and pool raw values at each draw. Preserve same VM weights; report individual session and LOO stability. Scores are conditional engineering diagnostics, not validated population confidence intervals.

failure_policy: Keep all slots and all failures. Technical/source/lifecycle faults stop remaining jobs; no selective replacement. A failed engineering score holds publication. Old4/8status never reclassified.
readiness: source-slot truthful driver plus real-process boundary selfcheck
probe spans only outside primary timing
independent review of config/workflow/analyzer before push
native_token_lane: Still separately needs isolated profile; no real model call authorized by this protocol file alone

files_owned.probe: probe/rpc_probe.py and auxiliary_probe.py and one selfcheck
files_owned.lead: harness configuration, workflow, manifest, integration, source gates and resource cleanup

flattened_harness: All implementation modules copied to one .github/c2-context-qualification root at integration
probe_entrypoint: auxiliary_probe.py --run after session_driver.py --run, under the same cache-pin child coordinator
